subject: Recap + onboarding map for Data Harbor POC
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@dataharbor.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Recap + onboarding map for Data Harbor POC

Hi Sanjay — great to meet on the call earlier. Quick written recap so we have the same priorities and next steps. I attached a short Mutual Action Plan (MAP) with owners and dates (MAP_DataHarbor_v1.xlsx).

Call highlights / scope
- Goal: Verify relevance of Redwood inference for Data Harbor search reranking + entity extraction on customer logs.
- Success criteria: 5k queries/day sustained, median generation latency < 200ms, extraction F1 >= 0.82 on provided sample.
- Assets we need: redacted sample logs (S3 link or CSV), list of target endpoints, procurement contact for any licensing/contract steps.

Proposed 2-week POC plan (high level)
1) Day 0–2: Stand up eval instance (we’ll provision DH-eval) + ingest sample data
2) Day 3–7: Baseline runs and config tuning (tokenization, prompt templates)
3) Day 8–12: Latency/cost tuning (batching + prefix caching) + run success metrics
4) Day 13–14: Wrap-up and next-step recommendation

Immediate next steps (action items)
- Sanjay: Confirm who owns procurement and share a redacted sample dataset (we can accept S3 URL or secure upload).
- Data Harbor: Confirm whether SSO/IAM is required for the eval instance this week.
- Jonas/Karthik: Schedule a short integration session; suggested windows Tue/Wed 10–11am PT.

Attachments: MAP_DataHarbor_v1.xlsx (owners, timeline, basic success metrics)

If the timeline needs to shift, call it out — happy to compress or extend depending on priority.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber

Hi Sanjay — Marissa here on the onboarding team. Wanted to check in because our telemetry shows the DH-eval instance has been provisioned but we haven’t received any API calls or data uploads. Common blockers we see: IAM/SSO not yet configured, sample dataset upload pending, or the team is deprioritizing the POC.

If helpful, we can run a 30-minute office hours session this week to walk through the upload and validate the first inference call. Karthik can join to help with prompt templates and latency tuning.

Please let us know which is true so we can either: 
- schedule hands-on onboarding (we’ll send a calendar invite), or
- pause the eval to avoid accruing costs and re-start when you’re ready, or
- re-scope to a smaller spike if internal bandwidth is limited.

Sanjay / procurement team — small follow-up from our side. We’ve been parked for a few days and want to avoid wasted cycles on both sides. Two quick options: 

A) Pause the POC: we’ll suspend the eval instance (no further charges) and re-activate when you say the project is back on the roster.
B) Schedule a 30-minute onboarding office hour in the next 48 hours — we’ll bring Karthik and a runtime engineer to validate the first call and walk the MAP.

If neither works, an honest two-line reply about priority would be perfect so we can either set a tentative restart date or close the POC until you’re ready. I also attached a short onboarding checklist (onboarding-checklist.pdf) that customers find useful for quick wins.

Calendar link for office hours: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=redwood-office-hours
